item.title: Physicists divided on how the Universe works
item.description: A worldwide survey of physicists found little agreement on the universe's biggest mysteries, with no majority backing any single explanation.

item.title: Global Warming Disrupts 400-Year Climate Link Between Oceans
item.description: The Indian and Pacific oceans have been climatically connected for centuries, but scientists say that link is now breaking down in an exceptional way.

item.title: Physicists Find Hidden Curveball in Quantum Light
item.description: Researchers have experimentally demonstrated the optical Magnus effect for the first time, showing that a tightly focused laser interacts most strongly.
